capabilities: Create and open today's daily page automatically at startup
Run a pomodoro, countdown or stopwatch timer with status-bar display
Manage a To do / Doing / Done kanban board split into categories
Carry unfinished tasks and forward-dated notes to later pages with age badges
Store the board and notes as ordinary Markdown code blocks and callouts
extras: Not yet in the Community directory; the README gives manual installation steps and warns to disable the core Daily notes plugin's open-on-startup to avoid conflicts.
motivation: The author frames it after the studiolo, the small private study of Renaissance palaces, giving you one such focused room for each day.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes gives you a blank page, with no built-in way to plan the day, track tasks across lanes, or see what you left unfinished on earlier days.
summary: Daily-page plugin that turns each day's note into a pomodoro timer, a categorized To do/Doing/Done kanban board, and note sections with task carry-over.
